title: Validate a prefixed identifier
note: ABC followed by exactly three digits. Ignore case also permits abc123.

title: Exclude characters
note: Empty strings are allowed. The recipe excludes a, b, c and d; Ignore case also excludes A, B, C and D.
rules:
start
text without: a, b, c, d
end

title: Read a line rule
note: Search mode finds a line ending with at least three digits; the prefix may include more digits. Entire string mode requires the match to cover the whole example.
rules:
line start
any text
3 digits
line end

title: Match a date shape
note: YYYY-MM-DD shape only. Impossible dates such as 2026-02-31 also match; validate calendar values separately.

title: Match a version shape
note: Three numeric parts with literal dots. Leading zeros are allowed, and prerelease suffixes are rejected. This is not full SemVer.

title: Match a hex color
note: Six hex digits after #, in either letter case. Only #RRGGBB; no shorthand, alpha or other CSS color forms.

title: Match an invoice ID shape
note: INV- followed by 2–6 ASCII digits. Leading zeros are allowed; verify invoice records separately.
